book.name: 1 Peter Eiwa ove tuturoda Peter mi God da gerari embomaida yai gagurisina.
book.commonName: 1 Peter Eiwa ove tuturoda Peter mi God da gerari embomaida yai gagurisina.
book.title: 1 Peter Eiwa ove tuturoda Peter mi God da gerari embomaida yai gagurisina.

content: Peter mi God da gerari embomai ainkain awamaneda butu dodo evekara edo yai neneida maunsitera ategesisina.
Na awa Peter, Iesu Keriso da aposil.
Nanemi imondemane, God da gerari embomai, ainkain itomane butu dodo evekara edo yai Pontusi, Galesia, Kapadosia, Asia edo Baitenia ainda, maundo isima edo ewa, ove eiwa gagurena.

God Mamo mi ainda Asisi ami imomane tatajido gerisina dá imo gisi jipapa edo gosisina ango. Edo God mi ango esisina awa, imomane Iesu Keriso da ge kera awate edo ainda ororomi imomane teiarate. God da dave ari de béga de itomane doda matawa sirari beda edo are.
Iesu Keriso awa kaenato tumonda ari wasiride, awatedo God dasiga ore.

Kaena God, Badari kaenato Iesu Keriso da Mamo, dasiga ore. God mi Iesu Keriso da betedo erarida toda ami ainda do ari tega itaebé kaenato yai piesiri engari teka buritera. Awatedo kaenato tumonda ari wasiride God da yai isira,
edo rorae davegave utuda God mi ainda embomai awaembo sima edo eira awa inemane bawa. Rorae awa depeka ari tao ae, edo beyae itaede, edo ainda duroka mana sisigaina.
Edo itomane gebé ari Iesu da yai pipiteiwowo God da gorobami imomane dedegedo eira, God mi iji beaoda itomane toregaribé matu siya ari awa itomane yai arapa arate sisina.
Imomane eiwa kotembesite duboyawa bajinabé ewa. Awarata boroko, iji tupo awa, God mi bawari neide kainde dosiri ami esiri dubo vevera etewa.

Bawari angogomi itomane gebé ari awa dave ko beyae awa arapa aina. Edo gold, mina bajinabé piedo bari rorae, awa itae aina. Ata itomane gebé ari Iesu da yaida mina, ami gold daginegari isira. Embomi gold awa niyao doda pisido bavedo gido era. Ata God mi bawari neide kainde itomane yai douri gundo eira awa itomane gebé ari bavedo gain. Edo itomane gebé ari awa dave gido, iji ainde Iesu Keriso tekago gumbari awa, inemane dasiga ari de tou ari de taogari de awa bawa.

Imomane Iesu gae, ata embo awa dubobudo ewa. Daedo iji boroko einde imomane embo awa gae, rata itomane gebé ari ainda yai piedo ewa. Edo itomane gebé arida mina beaoda awa toregari God mi imondemane pieuri budo ewa. Awatedo imomane dubodave eite do yawa edo ewa, embo enemboda gemi udugedo tari tao ae.
Edo peroveta mane ainkain God da dave ari itomane yai arapa ain sisina karigedo esitera, awamanemi nongo edo God mi imomane toregaini eiwawa kakowa edo udugedo gain esitera.

Edo iji awa gumbae gisida Keriso da Asisi mi peroveta maneda doda karigeuri gido esitera awa, memesi jiwae awa Keriso mi baina, edo taogari jiwae ainda yai amboda gumaina. Edo awamanemi Keriso embo averi, edo iji bé nonde awa idegaini awa gain daredo esitera.

God mi awamaneda yai esiri arapada gositera awa ge ro awamanemi karigedo esitera awa awamane embo ae, ata imomane embo. Edo iji boroko einde, embobo ainkain bino dave imondemane karigesitera, awamanemi ge eiwa tetero gositewa. Asisi Kotopu awa God mi utuda edo piesiri gupusina, ami awamane kondade esiri bino awa karigesitera. Edo anelamane daedo ge einda mokabé gain jipapa era.
God imomane dao sisina awa kotopu, awatedo imomane daedo kotopu ewo.

Awatedo itomane kotembari awa siya ewo, edo imomane akuta dedegeteite itomane tumonda ari berari God da dave arida yai piewo. God mi awawa itomane yai kundo gumain eira, iji ainde Iesu Keriso utuda edo gumaina.
Imomane, kera ari mamai ango, God da ge kera edo ewo. Edo dá imomane gisi God da ge gae itomane tamopisida jipapa bebegae ambo ambo edo esitewa ango, boroko ainyae.
Awarata, dá ango God ami imomane dao sisina awa kotopu, imomane daedo iwata berarida kotopu ewo.
Edo God da Ove Gaiarida ge dá ango isira awa, “Na awa kotopu, awatedo kotopu edo ewo.”

God mi embo da da ainda buro awa katain eira. Edo ine embo dao vitarida edo dao wotarida awa katari inono aina. Awatedo inemane God da yai benunu site ‘Mamo’ tedo ewa gido, iji tupo angode imomane butu einda isite, itomane tou ari bajina God da yai pipiteite imomane akuta iwata kawata ewo.

Imomane awa gari bé, iji angode God mi imomane embo mina piedo itomane apiye ewowoda iwata ari moka itae ae awamaneda ambo ambo ari deda awa imomane udegesisina, ainda mina piari awa rorae damana gambari, silver ko gold ango ae.

Ata mina God mi pipisisina awa Keriso da ororo deposi. Dá ango embomi wo sipu mai gini itae edo bubuko itae awa rorou ango deoro betoro God da yai pisido era, God mi ainda Mai itomane jimbo beyae awaembo piesiri embobomi detero besisina.
Edo God mi embo awa avigesisina butu gumbae gisida. Ata ami iji beao einde embo awa arapada esiri idegesisina imomane embo.

Aindabé Keriso buro awa esisina, itomane gebé ari God da yai piedo ewa. God mi Keriso betarida jiri erorisina edo ainda yai taogari pipisisina, awatedo itomane gebé ari edo tumonda ari awa God da yai.

Imomane God da gebé awa kera etewo ainda Asisi mi itomane jimbo beyae teiesiri itae esisina. Ango esiri gebé ari nanonameji itomaneda yai kotembari davebémi dubo mina bara edo ewa. Awatedo boroko, do jimbo beyae itaedemi, iji matawa dubo mina bara ewo.
Imomane engari teka buritewa. Edo betarida vemi imomane engae, ata betari tao aeda vemi. Ve eiwa awa God da ge, edo awa wasiride edo natopo itaina.
Gebé,

content.text: Edo emboda taogari awa kinyada koko ango.
Edo kinya mumuya edo eira, edo kinyada koko tokedo wotedo eira.
mi sisina awa natopo isima edo eira.”

content: Edo ge eiwa awa bino dave embomaimi itomane yai karigesitera.

footnotes.text: aposil awa Guriki da ge apostolos edo gumbari. Ainda moka awa ‘piari mambari embo’. Iesu Keriso mi Peter embomai gao ari kaviegorote, edo ainda bino dave karigarate tedo piesiri maunsisina (Matthew 10:1-8; Luke 6:12-16).
Badari awa God da dao da (1). Ainda moka awa ‘Na awa Natopo Itari’ (Exodus 3:14-15). Ge Moka Teteka, ove gaiari einda gunda awa daedo giwo.
